title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Season 05 Patch Notes

facts.text: Black Ops 7 Season 05 official patch notes were published July 22, 2026 by Treyarch.
FG42 was introduced as a new Assault Rifle in Season 05.
Treyarch nerfed the AN-94 hyperburst so body shots in its maximum-damage range no longer produce the previous 4-shot kill profile.
Season 05 Ranked increased base SR loss to -25 in Platinum, -30 in Diamond, and -40 in Crimson.
Opponent Rank Adjustments in Ranked now apply only when the opponent is at least three Rank Tiers above or below the player's current Rank.
Season 05 added Frequency, Vertigo and other maps to multiple Ranked Play mode pools.
Zombies Rogue Run reduced zombie spawns per round and now starts players with full Armor Health plus three armor plates in reserve.
Zombies Rogue Run now transfers Ammo Mods when a player replaces a weapon reward in the same slot.
Season 05 includes fixes for both Astra Malorum and Ashes of the Damned, including collision and map-specific gameplay issues.
